details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") that runs at install time and sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing only host metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the current working directory, and the npm/node version string. The request sets an X-Beacon-Package header identifying the package. The package README describes it as an authorized dependency-confusion test that reports only that it was installed; no environment variables, tokens, credential files, or file contents are read or transmitted, and no further payload is downloaded or executed.
